title: Analista de Desenvolvimento de Software III
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Desenvolvimento de Software III em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Somos a fintech do Grupo Energisa, que há mais de 120 anos leva energia de qualidade a milhões de brasileiros e impulsiona o desenvolvimento do país. Aqui na Voltz, nosso propósito é acelerar a inclusão digital e financeira de clientes em todo o Brasil.

Desde 2021, construímos soluções inovadoras que atendem todo o ecossistema do Grupo Energisa, empresa, clientes e fornecedores . Atuamos como um hub de produtos financeiros escaláveis, geradores de valor e focados em transformar a experiência de quem utiliza serviços essenciais.

Estamos em constante evolução e buscamos pessoas que queiram construir o futuro com a gente, com inovação, tecnologia, impacto real e foco no cliente.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Ser o owner técnico de um domínio ou subsistema, garantindo evolução segura e saudável ao longo do tempo.
  • Garantir que o domínio opere com SLOs acordados (latência/erros/disponibilidade) e trabalhar ativamente para melhorar a confiabilidade.
  • Liderar planejamento técnico e execução do domínio: decomposição, dependências, riscos, execução e validação.
  • Elevar consistentemente o nível técnico do time: boas práticas, revisão forte, referências, documentação e padrões.
  • Ser referência técnica interna: apoiar decisões complexas, destravar discussões e reduzir retrabalho.
  • Liderar resposta a incidentes do seu domínio: mitigação, RCA rigoroso e ações preventivas estruturais.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • TypeScript + Node.js (async/await, promises, error handling; event loop, streams e concorrência).
  • Desenvolvimento de APIs REST com OpenAPI (contratos, validação e status codes).
  • SQL (Postgres): consultas, migrations, otimização de queries e índices.
  • Git e fluxo de PRs (commits pequenos, rebase e resolução simples de conflitos).
  • Testes automatizados (unitários, integração e contrato) com Jest.
  • CI/CD e deploy: pipeline (lint/test/build/deploy), smoke tests, variáveis e logs.
  • Observabilidade: logs estruturados, métricas básicas e tracing superficial.
  • Mensageria e resiliência (BullMQ/RabbitMQ): retry, DLQ, idempotência e ordering quando necessário.
  • Performance e escalabilidade: profiling, gargalos comuns e trade-offs.
  • System design básico aplicado: rate limit, circuit breaker, bulkhead e degradação graciosa.
  • Concorrência e integridade: locks e consistência (otimista/pessimista).
  • Noções de NoSQL e cache (TTL e riscos de inconsistência).
  • Gestão de incidentes: mitigação, RCA/post-mortem e ações preventivas.


Informações adicionais:

  • Vale alimentação ou Refeição para fazer as compras para sua casa ou comer no seu restaurante preferido;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico para você e sua família;
  • Previdência privada para sua reserva financeira e investimentos;
  • Seguro de Vida, para dar mais tranquilidade a você e a quem você ama;
  • Participação nos lucros, como incentivo pelo seu trabalho e resultados;
  • Programas de qualidade de vida que garantem o bem-estar e promovem a saúde dos nossos colaboradores;
  • Wellhub que te dá acesso a mais de 18 mil academias no Brasil.


Se você possui os pré requisitos da vaga, faça sua candidatura e fique atento nas dicas:


- Durante a jornada do processo de seleção, a comunicação será via e-mail ou por telefone.

- Certifique que seus dados estão atualizados e fique de olho na sua caixa. de e-mail, sem esquecer da caixa de spam.

- Fique atento nas ligações, os nossos telefones corporativos possuem variação de DDD.

title: Paid Ads QA Auditor - Global
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Paid Ads QA Auditor - Global em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you obsessive about catching what others miss?


Do you notice inconsistencies without being told where to look?


Do you get satisfaction from identifying errors before they become problems?


Final question: when faced with a challenge, do you get excited or run away?


If that sounds like you, you may be the perfect fit for our Paid Ads QA role.


At Crisp, we're on a mission to help 10,000 law firms each grow their revenue by $10,000,000 over the next 10 years, creating a $10 billion impact in the legal industry.


Our Paid Ads team is responsible for executing paid media campaigns that power our law firm clients’ brand awareness and growth across major digital platforms. These campaigns are deployed across hundreds of client accounts and multiple platforms simultaneously.


This role exists to ensure those campaigns are executed accurately, consistently, and in alignment with internal standards and client intent.


This is a non-client-facing, audit-focused role that requires extreme attention to detail, strong system thinking, and the discipline to identify and document discrepancies with zero tolerance for preventable error.


However, it is not a “task-ing” role, or a role where you’ll be constantly told what to do - you’ll be expected to self-sufficiently spot and correct errors, but most importantly, get ahead of them before even happening, including improving existing systems.

title: Consultor(a) Funcional Salesforce - Pleno
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor(a) Funcional Salesforce - Pleno em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Consultor(a) Funcional Salesforce (Sales & Service Cloud)

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.


Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?


Qual será o seu papel?

Como consultor Funcional, você atuará como Key User funcional especializado em Salesforce Sales Cloud e Service Cloud, sendo a ponte entre o time comercial (vendas e atendimento) e as áreas técnicas de TI. Seu principal objetivo é garantir a correta utilização da plataforma, aumentar a produtividade dos usuários, traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos funcionais e apoiar a evolução contínua dos processos de CRM, sempre com foco na experiência do cliente e na eficiência operacional.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Apoiar usuários comerciais no uso diário do Salesforce, tirando dúvidas, resolvendo problemas de navegação e promovendo boas práticas.
  • Executar atividades operacionais relacionadas a processos de vendas (ex.: criação e acompanhamento de oportunidades, leads, contratos) e atendimento (casos, resolução de solicitações).
  • Detalhar requisitos de negócio junto aos times de vendas, marketing e serviços, transformando demandas em especificações funcionais claras para o time técnico.
  • Validar soluções funcionais antes da liberação em produção, realizando testes de aceitação (UAT) em Sales Cloud e Service Cloud.
  • Homologar novas funcionalidades, fluxos e relatórios, garantindo que atendam aos critérios de negócio e qualidade.
  • Identificar gargalos e melhorias nos processos comerciais e de relacionamento com clientes, propondo ajustes na configuração ou no uso do sistema.
  • Participar de rituais ágeis (daily, review, planning) com o time de CRM, trazendo a visão do negócio.
  • Criar e manter documentação de suporte, manuais e treinamentos para usuários finais.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência prática comprovada em Salesforce Sales Cloud e Service Cloud (mínimo 2 anos atuando como key user, analista funcional ou consultor).
  • Conhecimento sólido de processos de vendas , CRM e atendimento ao cliente (ex.: ciclo de leads, oportunidades, casos, SLAs).
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos funcionais claros e testáveis.
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita para interagir com usuários negócio e times técnicos.
  • Visão de processo e pensamento analítico para identificar melhorias e resolver problemas.
  • Perfil colaborativo, paciente e didático para treinar e apoiar usuários com diferentes níveis de maturidade digital.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Possuir certificações Salesforce, como Salesforce Certified Administrator ou Sales Cloud Consultant / Service Cloud Consultant.
  • Tiver experiência com configurações básicas na plataforma (criação de campos, objetos, perfis, fluxos de aprovação, relatórios e dashboards).
  • Demonstrar conhecimento em ferramentas de automação (Flow, Process Builder) ou integrações (API, middleware).
  • Já tiver atuado em projetos de implantação ou migração de CRM.
  • Apresentar familiaridade com métricas comerciais (funnel de vendas, tempo médio de resposta, NPS, etc.) e capacidade de criar KPIs no Salesforce.
  • Ter experiência em setores regulados (financeiro, utilities, telecom) que exigem governança e rastreabilidade.
  • Mostrar proatividade na gestão de mudanças e no treinamento de novos usuários (produção de materiais e workshops).


Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sales Development Representative em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sales Development Representative — U.S. Home Service Software

Location: Remote — Brazil


Schedule: U.S. business hours

Company: Local Business Pro

Role Type: Full-time / Contractor to start


About Local Business Pro

Local Business Pro is a CRM, field service management, and AI-powered communication platform built for home service businesses.


We help companies like pest control businesses, HVAC companies, electricians, plumbers, arborists, general contractors, and other service-based businesses manage their customer relationships, jobs, follow-up, scheduling, payments, and communication in one place.


Our product is also heavily focused on AI. We are building tools that help local service companies answer calls, follow up with leads, organize customer communication, and automate parts of their operations so they can grow without losing the personal touch that makes their business successful.

We are looking for an experienced Sales Development Representative based in Mexico who can help us grow in the U.S. home service market.


About the Role

This is not a basic appointment-setting role.

We are looking for someone who can manage a full sales development pipeline, build and nurture relationships, understand customer pain points, and create qualified opportunities through consultative selling.


You will be working with U.S.-based home service companies and channel partners to introduce Local Business Pro, identify gaps in their current systems, and help move qualified opportunities toward demos, onboarding, and long-term customer success.


You will also play an important role in making sure new customers are handed off properly to our Client Success team. That means setting the right expectations during the sales process, documenting customer needs, and helping ensure that every new client has a strong start after they sign up.


What You’ll Do

You will be responsible for prospecting, qualifying, and nurturing sales opportunities with U.S. home service businesses.


You will manage your own pipeline inside our CRM, follow up with leads, book qualified demos, and help move opportunities through the sales process.


You will work with channel partners and referral partners to create joint-selling opportunities and build long-term relationships that lead to high-quality customers.


You will use consultative selling and gap-selling methods to understand where prospects are struggling with missed calls, poor follow-up, messy scheduling, disconnected systems, lack of visibility, or manual processes.


You will learn our software deeply so you can speak confidently about CRM, field service management, AI receptionist tools, automations, customer communication, and operational workflows.


You will help prepare strong handoffs to the Client Success team by documenting the customer’s goals, pain points, expectations, and setup needs.


You will help make sure customers are sold the right way, with clear expectations, so they have a higher chance of long-term success.


What We’re Looking For

title: Specialist AI Engineer / Builder (LLM & Healthcare) | Remote Job
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Specialist AI Engineer / Builder (LLM & Healthcare) | Remote Job em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The Challenge

Every year, the healthcare industry loses billions due to billing failures. We are building the missing link that closes this gap with AI.

We are growing fast, with real operations, active customers, and new partners in the pipeline. We are looking for a builder who wants to help turn our current product into a platform with global scale.


Why This Role Might Be for You

Here, autonomy, ownership, and initiative are part of the daily routine. We are not looking for someone who already knows everything. Not knowing is part of the process. What matters to us is investigative curiosity, strong execution, and a genuine desire to learn.

You will work across both execution and strategy: from writing code to helping shape product and technical decisions. This is a role for someone who can propose new models, spot revenue opportunities, and also dig into data manually when needed to make sure the solution is truly accurate.

Speed, urgency, and attention to detail are essential to how we build.


Key Responsibilities

Your mission will be to help lead the evolution of our AI capabilities.

Today: Execution and Precision

  • Refine and optimize models already in production using AWS Bedrock, continuously improving accuracy and performance.
  • Validate data, rules, and outputs manually when needed. In healthcare, data quality is non-negotiable.
  • Monitor denial patterns and implement fast feedback loops so the system improves continuously.

Tomorrow: Scale and Architecture

  • Help evolve our infrastructure into a robust ecosystem using RAG pipelines and vector databases.
  • Move from a centralized AI solution toward a network of specialized models by context and insurance payer.
  • Contribute to fine-tuning proprietary models using our historical data to create a unique competitive advantage.


What We’re Looking For

  • Investigative curiosity: You want to understand complex medical billing rules and are motivated to master a difficult domain. Healthcare experience is not required.
  • Bias for action: You move fast, take initiative, and understand that speed matters in an early-stage company.
  • Hands-on coding ability: Solid practical experience with Python or Go, plus experience working with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or AWS Bedrock.
  • Builder mindset: You enjoy creating robust systems from scratch and care deeply about precision, reliability, and business impact.


What We Offer

  • Early-stage impact: Be one of the early team members in a fast-growing company and help shape both the architecture and the culture.
  • High-level technical challenge: Work on real business problems using modern generative AI.
  • Strong team: Work with ambitious, high-performing people who care about building something meaningful.
  • Remote flexibility: 100% remote work, open to candidates based in Brazil.
  • Long-term upside: Potential equity participation for people who help build the business with us.
  • Legacy: Your work will leave a real mark on the product, the codebase, and the company’s story.

title: Creative Producer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Creative Producer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

AI Creative Producer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM


About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. With a global audience of over 200 million listeners, we are redefining entertainment through episodic audio storytelling across diverse genres. We are seeking a highly organized and creative Creative Producer to manage and oversee the end-to-end production of high-quality audio content.

Role Overview

As a Creative Producer , you will play a key role in managing the end-to-end production process of audio content across various formats on Pocket FM. You will collaborate closely with writers, voice artists, creators, and production teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality episodes. The role requires strong operational management, creative oversight, and the ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders to deliver compelling audio experiences for our listeners.



Key Responsibilities

1. AI Voice Evaluation & Platform Coordination

Evaluate and benchmark AI-generated voices across platforms, maintaining a curated repository of approved voices. Continuously assess new features, tools, and model updates to enhance voice quality. Partner with product and AI voice platform teams to optimize voice solutions (including language-specific improvements such as Spanish).

2. Production Planning & Pipeline Management

Work with content and production teams to plan episode pipelines, forecast deliverables, and ensure timely execution of projects. Maintain visibility on production timelines and proactively address bottlenecks.

3. Stakeholder Collaboration

Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Content, Editorial, Marketing, Product, and Quality Control to ensure alignment on production goals, timelines, and quality standards. Share learnings and best practices across teams and geographies.

4. Production Quality Oversight

Partner with the QC team to review and approve episodes, ensuring adherence to quality benchmarks and creative intent. Identify and resolve issues related to voice quality, narration, sound design, and technical consistency prior to release.

5. Audience Feedback Monitoring & Optimization

Monitor listener feedback, user comments, and performance metrics to identify areas of improvement in content quality and engagement. Collaborate with relevant teams to implement enhancements and optimize the overall listening experience.

6. Process & Workflow Optimization

Continuously improve production workflows, creator management practices, and operational efficiency. Document processes, guidelines, and best practices to enable consistent and scalable content production.

7. Deliverables & Performance Expectations

Ensure timely delivery of all assigned episodes in line with targets. Drive structured coordination across stakeholders, resulting in high-quality, QC-approved audio content. Contribute to process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-team collaboration.



Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in content production, creator management, or media production.
  • Strong understanding of audio storytelling, podcast production, or audiobook production workflows .
  • Proven experience working with creators, voice artists, or creative production teams.
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to work in fast-paced environments and handle high-volume content production.
  • Self-motivated with strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive mindset.

Technical Business Analyst – FIX Protocol / Trading Applications

We are looking for a Technical Business Analyst with strong experience in FIX Protocol and trading applications to support technology initiatives within a global financial services environment.

This role requires a professional who can work closely with business stakeholders, product teams, application development teams and vendors to gather, analyze, document and validate business and technical requirements for trading-related systems.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with SQL queries, UNIX log analysis, functional specifications, data flows, system integrations and UAT support .

Key responsibilities

  • Gather, analyze and document business, functional and technical requirements for trading applications.
  • Work closely with business stakeholders, developers, vendors and product teams to define and validate technology solutions.
  • Create and maintain functional specifications, business rules, exception rules and process documentation.
  • Analyze system data across multiple platforms, including UNIX, FIX, Oracle, SQL Server and mainframe environments .
  • Perform SQL queries and UNIX log analysis to support requirements definition, issue investigation and validation.
  • Translate business needs into clear technical requirements for development teams.
  • Support data sourcing activities, validating data completeness from acquisition through report or system delivery.
  • Define and support testing requirements, test cases and UAT activities.
  • Conduct functional walkthroughs and obtain business sign-off.
  • Track project risks, defects, change requests and delivery status.
  • Support multiple projects or workstreams in parallel within the software development lifecycle.

Required experience

  • 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst or Technical Business Analyst .
  • Strong experience with FIX Protocol .
  • Experience working with trading applications or capital markets platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL queries .
  • Experience with UNIX log analysis .
  • Ability to write clear functional and technical requirements.
  • Experience creating FSDs , business requirements, test cases and UAT documentation.
  • Good understanding of system integrations, data flows and application troubleshooting.
  • Ability to translate technical concepts to business stakeholders and business requirements to technical teams.
  • Experience working with developers, vendors, product managers and business SMEs.
  • Advanced English for communication with global teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience in financial services, brokerage, investment banking, wealth management or capital markets.
  • Knowledge of Oracle, SQL Server or mainframe environments.
  • Experience with data governance standards.
  • Experience leading small projects or coordinating workstreams.
  • Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery models.

Ideal profile

The ideal candidate is not a purely functional BA. We are looking for a hands-on Technical Business Analyst who understands trading systems, can analyze FIX messages, read UNIX logs, write SQL queries, document requirements clearly and work directly with both business and technology teams.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Scientist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us:

Toluna is the global research and insights leader that enables businesses to make smarter, data-driven decisions—faster. For 26 years, we have partnered with the world’s leading brands, delivering transformative impact through our advanced technology platform, comprehensive solution portfolio, expansive global first-party panel, and world-class team of leading research experts. Since 2019, we’ve made significant investments in artificial intelligence to enhance automation, accelerate insight delivery, and unlock deeper understanding at scale. With 40+ offices worldwide, Toluna operates in 70+ countries, redefining the future of insights. Learn


Introduction:

We are seeking a Data Scientist to join our global advanced analytics team. In this role, you’ll lead the design and execution of advanced analytical solutions that inform strategic decision-making for our clients. You’ll leverage your deep technical expertise and market research experience to drive innovation, mentor junior analysts, and deliver impactful, data-driven recommendations.


This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate analytics professional who thrives at the intersection of data science, business strategy, and storytelling, with growing expectations around applied AI and intelligent automation.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design and implementation of advanced analytical frameworks to address complex business challenges across a variety of industries.
  • Partner with internal teams and clients to translate business objectives into analytical solutions, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities.
  • Design, build, and maintain practical analytics-facing AI-enabled solutions such as analytical agents, automated insights generation, or decision support tools using large language models or similar technologies.
  • Evaluate where AI can responsibly augment analytical work, including data preparation, model development, quality checks, insight synthesis, and delivery, while maintaining methodological rigor.
  • Partner with engineering, analytics, or product teams to operationalize AI-driven analytics in repeatable and scalable ways.
  • Deliver high-impact storytelling and visualization, distilling complex analyses into clear narratives that influence senior stakeholders.
  • Act as a trusted consultant, providing analytic guidance and thought leadership on market research methodologies, data interpretation, and advanced modeling.
  • Mentor and support junior analysts, reviewing outputs, sharing best practices, and fostering a culture of learning and quality.
  • Champion automation, standardization, and innovation, identifying opportunities to optimize workflows and analytical efficiency.
  • Stay current on emerging tools, data science techniques, and market trends to continuously enhance Toluna’s analytics capabilities.


Your profile:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data analytics, advanced analytics, or market research roles.
  • Bachelor’s or master's degree in data science, statistics, economics, computer science, or a related field.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python, R, SQL, SPSS and/or Sawtooth
  • Strong command of statistical modeling, segmentation, predictive analytics, and experimental design.
  • Proven ability to lead analytical projects from scoping to delivery, including stakeholder management and quality assurance.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, able to translate complex data findings into business implications.
  • Hands-on experience applying AI or machine learning in real-world analytics contexts, beyond academic or purely experimental work.
  • Familiarity with large language models and their practical use in analytics workflows, such as building or supervising AI agents, prompt-driven analysis, or automated insight generation.
  • Strong judgment around model quality, bias, explainability, and appropriate use of AI in client-facing analytical work.
  • Ability to clearly explain AI-driven approaches and limitations to non-technical stakeholders in plain business language.
  • Experience mentoring or leading junior analysts or cross-functional workstreams.
  • Must be fluent in English , with additional languages being a plus.


**Please submit your CV in English.


Our Values:

  • A cting with Ownership- Demonstrating individual accountability
  • B ringing a forward mindset- Being action-oriented, bold and entrepreneurial
  • C ollaborating with Curiosity- Exhibiting teamwork through togetherness
  • D iscussing openly, committing jointly- Sharing your views openly
  • E mbracing empathy- Being egoless & caring


What we offer:

At Toluna, we’re all about creating a welcoming, diverse workplace where everyone can thrive. We offer competitive pay, great benefits, and plenty of opportunities to grow within our global team. Inclusion and respect are at the heart of what we do. Our community connects over 72 million people across 70 countries. If you’re passionate about making an impact, we’d love to have you on board.


Other Benefits: Healthcare, dental care, life insurance, a meal voucher, a transportation voucher, and a language class subsidy.


Join our global team. We welcome big thinking and reward great work.

title: Ingeniero de Nube
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ingeniero de Nube em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Top Skills' Details

1.) 5 years of experience with software engineering and in designing and building cloud native integrations.

2.) 4 years of AWS development experience (specifically with serverless and event driven architectures). 75% of the role will be focused on Development (mostly new development).

3.) 2+ years of Architecture/Design experience. This consultant must understand high level AWS best practices for code development, security standards, how to best scale & conducting code reviews for the team. This Sr Consultant will be working directly with the business to gather requirements and work with the team to ensure best development practices for delivery.

3.) 5+ years with full stack engineering background (JavaScript / TypeScript preferred).

4.) Hands on experience integrating with NetSuite (SuiteTalk, SuiteScript) and Salesforce APIs.

Job Description:

Our Client is the nation’s leading independent service provider for critical telecommunications and renewable energy infrastructure. As our organization continues to grow through strategic acquisitions, our cloud ecosystem must remain scalable, secure, and well‑integrated. We are seeking an AWS leader who can architect and build seamless integrations across enterprise systems.


The Role

We are looking for a Senior AWS Developer (L3) with 5–7 years of experience , strong full‑stack engineering skills , and deep expertise in designing and building cloud‑native integrations. In this role, you will lead the development of APIs and data pipelines that connect AWS services with core business systems, specifically NetSuite , Salesforce , and other enterprise applications.

You will own the full lifecycle of integration development—from solution architecture, security design, and data modeling to hands‑on coding and deployment automation.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise System Integration

  • Architect, build, and maintain integrations between AWS , NetSuite , Salesforce , and other enterprise systems.
  • Design and implement RESTful APIs , event‑driven integrations, and data‑sync pipelines.
  • Lead integration efforts during M&A system consolidation , ensuring that data, logic, and system flows unify cleanly across legacy platforms.

AWS Engineering & Architecture

  • Build serverless and microservices‑based applications using Lambda , API Gateway , S3 , RDS , EventBridge , SNS/SQS , and related AWS services.
  • Develop secure, scalable backend solutions, including authentication, access control, observability, and resilience patterns.

Full‑Stack Development

  • Contribute to both backend and frontend engineering using modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks.
  • Build dashboards, administrative tools, and workflow components that support business integration processes.

Advanced Development & Data Workflows

  • Design and maintain high performance data transformations between platforms (Salesforce ↔ NetSuite ↔ AWS).‑performance data transformations between platforms (Salesforce ↔ NetSuite ↔ AWS).
  • Implement robust ETL/ELT patterns for large‑scale data migrations and cross‑platform synchronization.
  • Perform deep‑dive field mapping, data normalization, and validation across systems.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

  • Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Produce clear architectural diagrams, sequence flows, and Build‑vs‑Buy recommendations.
  • Lead technical discussions with internal teams and stakeholders from acquired companies.

Qualifications

Required Technical Skills

  • 5–7 years professional software engineering experience with increasing seniority.
  • Expert level AWS development experience , especially with serverless and eventdriven architectures.‑level AWS development experience ‑driven architectures.
  • Strong full‑stack engineering background (JavaScript / TypeScript preferred).
  • Proven track record developing REST APIs , microservices, and cloud‑native applications.
  • Hands‑on experience integrating with NetSuite (SuiteTalk, SuiteScript) and Salesforce APIs .
  • Strong data modeling skills and experience with large‑scale migration tooling.
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD and DevOps tooling (GitHub Actions, Copado, Gearset, etc.).

Soft Skills

  • Excellent English communication skills and the ability to document architectures clearly.
  • Strong analytical and root‑cause debugging skills.
  • Ability to collaborate with cross‑functional business and engineering teams.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with EventBridge , AppFlow , or enterprise iPaaS tools.
  • Background in M&A system consolidation or multi‑system enterprise architecture.

title: Ingeniero de Nube
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ingeniero de Nube em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Top Skills' Details

1.) 5 years of experience with software engineering and in designing and building cloud native integrations.

2.) 4 years of AWS development experience (specifically with serverless and event driven architectures). 75% of the role will be focused on Development (mostly new development).

3.) 2+ years of Architecture/Design experience. This consultant must understand high level AWS best practices for code development, security standards, how to best scale & conducting code reviews for the team. This Sr Consultant will be working directly with the business to gather requirements and work with the team to ensure best development practices for delivery.

3.) 5+ years with full stack engineering background (JavaScript / TypeScript preferred).

4.) Hands on experience integrating with NetSuite (SuiteTalk, SuiteScript) and Salesforce APIs.

Job Description:

Our Client is the nation’s leading independent service provider for critical telecommunications and renewable energy infrastructure. As our organization continues to grow through strategic acquisitions, our cloud ecosystem must remain scalable, secure, and well‑integrated. We are seeking an AWS leader who can architect and build seamless integrations across enterprise systems.


The Role

We are looking for a Senior AWS Developer (L3) with 5–7 years of experience , strong full‑stack engineering skills , and deep expertise in designing and building cloud‑native integrations. In this role, you will lead the development of APIs and data pipelines that connect AWS services with core business systems, specifically NetSuite , Salesforce , and other enterprise applications.

You will own the full lifecycle of integration development—from solution architecture, security design, and data modeling to hands‑on coding and deployment automation.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise System Integration

  • Architect, build, and maintain integrations between AWS , NetSuite , Salesforce , and other enterprise systems.
  • Design and implement RESTful APIs , event‑driven integrations, and data‑sync pipelines.
  • Lead integration efforts during M&A system consolidation , ensuring that data, logic, and system flows unify cleanly across legacy platforms.

AWS Engineering & Architecture

  • Build serverless and microservices‑based applications using Lambda , API Gateway , S3 , RDS , EventBridge , SNS/SQS , and related AWS services.
  • Develop secure, scalable backend solutions, including authentication, access control, observability, and resilience patterns.

Full‑Stack Development

  • Contribute to both backend and frontend engineering using modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks.
  • Build dashboards, administrative tools, and workflow components that support business integration processes.

Advanced Development & Data Workflows

  • Design and maintain high performance data transformations between platforms (Salesforce ↔ NetSuite ↔ AWS).‑performance data transformations between platforms (Salesforce ↔ NetSuite ↔ AWS).
  • Implement robust ETL/ELT patterns for large‑scale data migrations and cross‑platform synchronization.
  • Perform deep‑dive field mapping, data normalization, and validation across systems.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

  • Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Produce clear architectural diagrams, sequence flows, and Build‑vs‑Buy recommendations.
  • Lead technical discussions with internal teams and stakeholders from acquired companies.

Qualifications

Required Technical Skills

  • 5–7 years professional software engineering experience with increasing seniority.
  • Expert level AWS development experience , especially with serverless and eventdriven architectures.‑level AWS development experience ‑driven architectures.
  • Strong full‑stack engineering background (JavaScript / TypeScript preferred).
  • Proven track record developing REST APIs , microservices, and cloud‑native applications.
  • Hands‑on experience integrating with NetSuite (SuiteTalk, SuiteScript) and Salesforce APIs .
  • Strong data modeling skills and experience with large‑scale migration tooling.
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD and DevOps tooling (GitHub Actions, Copado, Gearset, etc.).

Soft Skills

  • Excellent English communication skills and the ability to document architectures clearly.
  • Strong analytical and root‑cause debugging skills.
  • Ability to collaborate with cross‑functional business and engineering teams.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with EventBridge , AppFlow , or enterprise iPaaS tools.
  • Background in M&A system consolidation or multi‑system enterprise architecture.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our engineering team builds agentic solutions that data and research teams utilize to transform petabytes of raw data into strategic intelligence. Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting — it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention

About The Role

We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS.

You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not.

The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.

As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will

  • Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration
  • Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators
  • Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI
  • Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why
  • Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation.
  • Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.

You Are Likely To Succeed If

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it
  • You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don’t let unfamiliar tech slow you down
  • You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day
  • You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction
  • You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment
  • You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure
  • You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it
  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)

What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.
